blind.description: A three-panel wooden folding screen or room divider. Each panel features a warm brown wooden frame with arched upper rails and square vertical posts capped with small pyramidal tops, connected by small hinges. The interior panels are painted with a decorative botanical/floral scene featuring creamy white and rust-red flowers with green foliage on a deep green ground.
blind.from_above: A three-segment shallow zigzag or open arc, with a straight central horizontal segment and two outer panels angled slightly forward, showing the four square post tops at the joints and ends.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 4 to 4.5 feet tall (roughly three-quarters the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 4.5 to 5 feet wide across its angled span.
